WITH marker_rows AS (SELECT e.id,e.task_id,COALESCE(e.job_id,'') AS job_id,e.kind,CASE WHEN LEFT(kind,11)='work_order.' AND JSON_GET_TYPE(payload_json)='object' THEN JSON_DELETE_KEY(JSON_DELETE_KEY(payload_json,'governance_snapshot'),'served_requirement_snapshot') ELSE payload_json END AS event_payload,e.at AS event_at
		FROM events_columnstore e
		WHERE e.workspace_id=? AND e.task_id IS NOT NULL AND e.task_id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
		AND (
			e.kind IN ('pipeline.bounced','work_order.claimed','work_order.updated') OR
			(e.kind IN ('github_issue.publication_retry','github_issue.publication_failed','github_issue.publication_published','review.publication_retry','review.publication_failed','review.publication_published','merge.failed','merge.confirmed','merge.reconciled','merge.blocked','merge.conflict_cleared','merge.conflict_fix_dispatched','merge.conflict_recovery_blocked','merge.conflict_dispatch_exhausted')) OR (e.kind IN ('work_order.released','review.completed','review.accepted','task.setup.changed') AND e.task_id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)) OR (e.kind IN ('work_order.claimed','work_order.lease_renewed') AND e.task_id IN (?,?,?,?,?))
		)
		ORDER BY event_at,id),
		marker_clock AS (SELECT CAST(? AS SIGNED) AS now_sec,CAST(? AS SIGNED) AS now_nanos),
		renewal_instants AS (SELECT id,task_id,job_id,event_payload,event_at,
		CASE WHEN valid=1 AND NOT (sec=-62135596800 AND nanos=0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lease_ok,
		sec AS lease_sec, nanos AS lease_nanos
		FROM (SELECT id,task_id,job_id,event_payload,event_at, valid, nanos,
			((yy DIV 400)*146097+(yy-(yy DIV 400)*400)*365+((yy-(yy DIV 400)*400) DIV 4)-((yy-(yy DIV 400)*400) DIV 100)+((153*mp+2) DIV 5)+d-1-719468-146097)*86400+h*3600+mi*60+s-tzsign*(tzh*3600+tzm*60) AS sec
			FROM (SELECT id,task_id,job_id,event_payload,event_at, nanos, tzsign, tzh, tzm, y, mo, d, h, mi, s,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 AND mo BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d>=1
			AND d<=CASE WHEN mo=2 THEN CASE WHEN MOD(y,4)=0 AND (MOD(y,100)<>0 OR MOD(y,400)=0) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END
				WHEN mo IN (4,6,9,11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END
			AND h<=23 AND mi<=59 AND s<=59 AND tzh<=24 AND tzm<=60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS valid,
		CASE WHEN mo<=2 THEN y+399 ELSE y+400 END AS yy,
		CASE WHEN mo>2 THEN mo-3 ELSE mo+9 END AS mp
		FROM (SELECT id,task_id,job_id,event_payload,event_at, shaped, tzlen,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t,1,4) AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS y,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t,6,2) AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS mo,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t,9,2) AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS d,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t,12,hlen) AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS h,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t,13+hlen,2) AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS mi,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t,16+hlen,2) AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS s,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 AND CHAR_LENGTH(t)-17-hlen-tzlen>1 THEN CAST(RPAD(SUBSTRING(t,19+hlen,LEAST(9,CHAR_LENGTH(t)-18-hlen-tzlen)),9,'0') AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS nanos,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 AND tzlen=6 AND SUBSTRING(t,CHAR_LENGTH(t)-5,1)='-' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS tzsign,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 AND tzlen=6 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t,CHAR_LENGTH(t)-4,2) AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS tzh,
		CASE WHEN shaped=1 AND tzlen=6 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t,CHAR_LENGTH(t)-1,2) AS SIGNED) ELSE 0 END AS tzm
		FROM (SELECT id,task_id,job_id,event_payload,event_at, t,
		CASE WHEN is_str=1 AND t IS NOT NULL AND t REGEXP '^[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]T([0-9]|[0-9][0-9]):[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9](Z|[+-][0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]|[.,][0-9]+(Z|[+-][0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]))$'
			AND ASCII(SUBSTRING(t,11,1))=84
			AND (ASCII(SUBSTRING(t,CHAR_LENGTH(t),1))=90 OR
				(ASCII(SUBSTRING(t,CHAR_LENGTH(t),1)) BETWEEN 48 AND 57 AND SUBSTRING(t,CHAR_LENGTH(t)-5,1) IN ('+','-')))
			THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS shaped,
		CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t,13,1)=':' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS hlen,
		CASE WHEN ASCII(SUBSTRING(t,CHAR_LENGTH(t),1))=90 THEN 1 ELSE 6 END AS tzlen
		FROM (SELECT id,task_id,job_id,event_payload,event_at, lease_text AS t, lease_string AS is_str FROM (SELECT id,task_id,job_id,event_payload,event_at,
		JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(event_payload,'lease_expires_at') AS lease_text,
		CASE WHEN event_payload REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[{][[:space:]]*("attempt_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*"lease_expires_at"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[0-9T:Z+.,-]+"|"lease_expires_at"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[0-9T:Z+.,-]+"([[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*"attempt_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"){0,1})[[:space:]]*[}][[:space:]]*$'
			AND JSON_GET_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT_JSON(event_payload,'lease_expires_at'))='string'
			THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lease_string
		FROM marker_rows WHERE kind='work_order.lease_renewed') src) named) shaped_rows) field_rows) civil_rows) epoch_rows),
		ranked_renewals AS (
			SELECT id,task_id,job_id,event_payload,event_at,lease_ok,lease_sec,lease_nanos,now_sec,now_nanos,
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY task_id,job_id ORDER BY lease_ok DESC,event_at DESC,id DESC) AS latest_rank,
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY task_id,job_id ORDER BY
					CASE WHEN lease_ok=1 AND (lease_sec>now_sec OR (lease_sec=now_sec AND lease_nanos>now_nanos)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
					lease_sec,lease_nanos,event_at,id) AS horizon_rank
			FROM renewal_instants CROSS JOIN marker_clock
		)
		SELECT id,task_id,job_id,kind,event_payload,event_at FROM marker_rows WHERE kind<>'work_order.lease_renewed'
		UNION ALL
		SELECT id,task_id,job_id,'work_order.lease_renewed',event_payload,event_at FROM ranked_renewals
		WHERE lease_ok=0 OR latest_rank=1 OR (horizon_rank=1 AND (lease_sec>now_sec OR (lease_sec=now_sec AND lease_nanos>now_nanos)))
		ORDER BY event_at,id
